about: Expected verdict of each check per driver branch, with the FINDINGS evidence behind it (validation/FINDINGS.md; result files under validation/results_gpu1 for 595 and validation/results_gpu2 for 580).

api.evidence: every FINDINGS run used the five checkpoint functions on both drivers

roundtrip.evidence: What worked: 50 cycles on a 2 GB job (fault_leak.json, both)

errors.evidence: What worked: calls in the wrong state, wrong PIDs (fault_errors.json, both)

sync_first_call.evidence: What breaks the job: a synchronize as the first CUDA call after the checkpoint (fault_repro_sync.json, fault_tail_ops_*, both)

managed_memory.evidence: What breaks the job: managed memory, 2/2 lost on 595, 1/1 survived on 580 (fault_uvm.json)

sigstop.evidence: What breaks the job: job stopped with SIGSTOP (fault_sigstop-2.json on 595, fault_sigstop.json on 580)

exit_while_paused.evidence: What worked: job that exits while paused, making no further CUDA call (fault_tail_ops_a.json, correctness files)

child_context.evidence: What worked: job whose child process has its own CUDA context (fault_child_cuda.json, both)

cgroup.evidence: What breaks the job: job in a memory-limited cgroup (fault_cgroup.json, both)

nccl_single_gpu.evidence: What breaks the job: NCCL process group on one GPU, 4/4 lost on 595, 2/2 fine on 580 (nccl1_*.json)

ipc_shared_memory.evidence: What breaks the job: CUDA memory shared between processes (fault_ipc.json, both)

restore_oom.evidence: What breaks the job: restore with too little free GPU memory, 4/4 on 595, 3/3 on 580 (fault_short_*, fault_retry_*)

size_sweep.evidence: What worked: 20 GB job (bench_size.json, gpu1); 16 GB checkpoints on both drivers (fault_ctlkill_restore.json)

controller_death.evidence: What worked: controller killed during a checkpoint (fault_ctlkill_ckpt.json, 595 only) and during a restore (fault_ctlkill_restore.json, both)

correctness.evidence: What worked: correctness, 33 runs, 388 cycles, all bit-identical (correctness files, both)
